note: The vertical's OWN transactions only. The campaign submits every tier-1 founding transaction before these (found_through_open is called, not copied), and tier 1's bindings are merged in front at fold time. Rows carrying a 'walk' field bind only that walk's evidence; the runner filters and strips the field before the shared census evaluator sees it, because a success-only wire reported as a stale binding on the failure walk would overstate nothing and still fail the fold.

bindings.label: relayed vertical: top up the campaign payer
bindings.note: An airdrop on a local validator; fee-side lamports, not collateral.

bindings.label: relayed vertical: fund the daemon's fee payer
bindings.note: An airdrop on a local validator; the daemon's hot fee payer, a distinct key from its attestation identity.

bindings.label: relayed vertical: fund the walker
bindings.note: An airdrop on a local validator; the walker pays its own fee and is credited the disclosed bounty by the walk.

bindings.label: relayed vertical: prepay the Source state and the three Resolution Funds
bindings.note: System transfers to precommitted, prepaid destinations; the exact top-ups are the operator's arithmetic.

bindings.label: relayed vertical: create the resolution-funding routing table
bindings.note: Address-lookup-table program: create, for the two over-packet funding frames (CreateFund and VerifyFundReady measured at 2,016 bytes vs 1,232). Routing is table data, never protocol authority.

bindings.label: relayed vertical: extend the resolution-funding routing table page *
bindings.note: Address-lookup-table program: extend pages for the funding table.

bindings.label: relayed vertical: a no-recovery Market creates its own Resolution funding
bindings.note: The first live execution of the e5b6923 no-recovery admission: the SHORT CreateFund frame (18 accounts, the two RecoveryPolicyV2 tail positions absent), coherence-checked against the authenticated material that names no recovery policy.

bindings.label: relayed vertical: activate the no-recovery Resolution funding
bindings.note: VerifyFundReady over the same short frame; the three compartments go Active and the Market stays Open + Consumed.

bindings.label: relayed vertical: prepay a terminal certificate destination
bindings.note: System transfers of exact rent to the success- and failure-kind certificate PDAs; the terminal routes allocate and assign but never fund.

bindings.label: relayed vertical: create the observation record for the observed slot
bindings.note: The keeper's act: the record PDA is seeded by the daemon's observed slot, so creation can only follow observation. First execution of this route on a live validator rather than a ProgramTest bank.

bindings.label: relayed vertical: create the relay routing table
bindings.note: Address-lookup-table program: create, covering the append/seal and consumption frames' non-signer coordinates. Routing is table data, never protocol authority.

bindings.label: relayed vertical: extend the relay routing table page *
relayed vertical: a sealed graduation resolves the market
bindings.note: The 28-account consumption as a packet-safe v0 transaction over the Market table — one of the family's two known over-packet wires. The sealed record's attested VirtualPool body reads CreatedPool, the venue deployment authenticates against the pinned synthetic-of-real release, and the Source state single-writes to Resolved.

bindings.label: relayed vertical: a silent relayer cannot make the market unresolvable
bindings.note: The funded deadline walk on a bare legacy transaction, past window.end + max_age by the devnet clock, paying a fresh walker exactly the manifest's disclosed bounty out of the market's own escrow. First execution on a live validator; the frame carries nothing of the relayer's.
